runtime: Pure Go. References were generated during development only. Runtime and Go tests do not invoke Python, Cairo, Manim, a browser, native libraries or subprocess renderers.

scope.ownership: Constructor copies input; Lengths returns a copy. Private pattern storage is immutable and safe to share between object copies and sampled frames. Nil means solid; zero-value non-nil pattern is invalid. Style interpolation switches the entire pattern at the endpoint.
scope.values: Finite nonnegative lengths, finite positive total; odd lists repeat once. Reject empty/all-zero/overflow patterns. Finite offsets reduce modulo period; positive SVG offsets advance into the pattern. Scaled rejects nonpositive/nonfinite scales, overflow and positive entries/offsets underflowing to zero; representable subnormal values remain valid.
scope.SVG: Presentation attributes, inline style and embedded CSS stroke-dasharray/stroke-dashoffset reuse the existing cascade and inheritance. Dash offset inherits independently of the array and is reduced only with the final array. Supports none, comma/ASCII whitespace separators, user units and existing absolute units; defs/use instances inherit independently. Uniform SVG transforms, symbol viewport transforms and final world normalization scale lengths and offset together.
scope.render: Flatten using existing CurveTolerance (default 0.02 pixels), then split by actual projected XY polyline distance. Preserve source vertices within each dash and reuse existing cap/join outlines. Reset phase per contour. Coalesce zero gaps, including consecutive zero entries. Join painted runs across a closed seam; a fully painted ring remains closed. Zero dashes use round dots or tangent-oriented square dots; butt dots have no coverage. Reveal trims before dashing. Fill is unchanged.
scope.export: StrokeAttributes emits full-precision normalized dasharray and offset. Solid explicitly emits none and zero to avoid inherited patterns. Existing SVG world-to-pixel transform supplies scale without doubling dash lengths.
scope.limit_behavior: Zero entries and dots count toward work/fragment budgets, including fragments subsequently merged. Errors abort rendering rather than dropping dashes or falling back to solid. Numeric inability to advance the contour or subdivision returns an explicit error.
boundaries: Curved length is the existing flattened-polyline approximation, not analytic arc length.
SVG dash percentage lengths, pathLength calibration, calc/var and !important are explicitly rejected.
Visible nonuniform/sheared SVG strokes retain the importer's explicit rejection.
Native object geometry transforms retain existing Style world-unit semantics; explicitly call Scaled when also scaling the dash style.
Image nodes do not apply vector dash paint, consistent with existing image fill/stroke behavior.
Fixed DashedLine API is unchanged. No claim of full Manim dash-count, animation or browser SVG parity.

fixtures.origin: Synthetic local SVG scenes; no third-party artwork.

from pathlib import Path
import cairosvg
p = Path('tests/data/svg')
for name in ['dash-cascade', 'dash-square-dots', 'dash-edge-cases']:
    cairosvg.svg2png(bytestring=(p/(name+'.svg')).read_bytes(), write_to=str(p/(name+'.png')))
CairoSVG.environment: Development generation used PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/homebrew/lib. Go tests require neither.
CairoSVG.comparison: One transparent frame per fixture, premultiplied 8-bit RGBA across all pixels/channels. MAE uses channel units 0..255; fraction counts pixels with any channel delta greater than 8. No reference normalization.
CairoSVG.coverage: Colors, curves, cascade, odd arrays, offsets, caps/joins, independent contours, closed seams, zero dashes, diagonal square dots, zero/consecutive-zero gaps. Remaining pixel differences are edge coverage differences.

Manim.environment: Development only: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, PYTHONPATH set to the read-only Manim source tree, DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/homebrew/lib.
Manim.generation: For Line([-3,0,0],[3,0,0]) and Square(side_length=2), call DashedVMobject(base, num_dashes=4, dashed_ratio=.5, dash_offset=offset, equal_lengths=True) at offsets 0, .25, .75. Record base and each dash's get_start_anchors() followed by get_end(), projected to XY. Line native pattern is [.75,1]; closed square pattern is [1,1]. Native SVG absolute offset = -Manim fractional offset * sum(native pattern). Serialize the six cases to dash-manim.json.
Manim.comparison: Compare all vertices and dash counts, sorting by dash starts to ignore ordering. Absolute Euclidean vertex tolerance 1e-9.
Manim.result: PASS: six static geometry cases. Manim fractional phase direction is opposite SVG positive absolute offset. No Manim raster/animation parity claim.
